audit.whatIsWrong: Level 3 was given to Jax though whys[2] calls it 'your single cleanest trade of the lane', and Level 6 was 'Skill' though whys[4] ends 'on a coinflip the duelist favourite is him'. Both disagree with the packet chart.
audit.why: At 3 Flawless Duet lands after Counter Strike's dodge window and Bladesurge resets burst him before its 13s rank-3 cooldown returns; at 6 Grandmaster-at-Arms adds resists on top of a stun he controls the timing of.
audit.corrected: Row 2 to Irelia and row 4 to Jax in both layers as one atomic group with matching ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike attributed an attack-speed steroid to Jax's ultimate and gave no cooldown numbers for the ability the whole lane is built around.
audit.why: Riot's R text gives bonus Armor and Magic Resist plus magic damage on every third attack — the attack-speed ramp is Relentless Assault, his passive. Counter Strike is 17/15/13/11/9s; Empower is 7/6/5/4/3s.
audit.corrected: The R's real effects and name written into spikes[1], mid and wants.foe[2]; Counter Strike's 17s/9s written into Key Ability Interactions and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Jax's ultimate is called 'Grandmaster's Might' in spikes[1], mid and wants.foe[2]; the real name is Grandmaster-at-Arms. Separately, whys[6], spikes[3] and late credit Irelia with a passive armour shred she does not have — Ionian Fervor is stacking attack speed plus bonus on-hit at max stacks.
audit.why: A player told his resists 'eat your shred' will keep autoing into a stat he is actually stacking against her on-hit damage; and the invented ability name is exactly the class of error this audit exists to remove.
audit.corrected: Real R name used throughout; shred language replaced with the on-hit ramp in whys[6] and spikes[3].

edits.before: Your R (Vanguard's Edge) can wall him so he can't Q-leap away, but his R (Grandmaster's Might) gives huge bonus armor/MR plus an attack-speed steroid — a 6v6 all-in is a coinflip unless his E is already on cooldown.
edits.after: Your R (Vanguard's Edge) can wall him so he can't Q-leap away, but his R (Grandmaster-at-Arms) gives bonus armour and MR plus magic damage every third hit — the all-in is a coinflip unless Counter Strike is already down.

edits.before: This is your only real window and it's narrow. At 4-5 your Bladesurge on-hit passive starts ramping and you can win short trades IF you fish his E first — never all-in while Counter Strike is up. At 6 your R can wall him so he can't Q-leap away, but his R (Grandmaster's Might) gives huge bonus armor/MR plus an attack-speed steroid, so a straight 6v6 is a coinflip unless his E is down. Get a lead here or the lane slips — once he has Trinity/Blade you stop out-trading him.
edits.after: This is your only real window and it's narrow. At 4-5 your Ionian Fervor stacks start ramping and you can win short trades IF you fish his E first — never all-in while Counter Strike is up, and it is 17s at rank 1. At 6 your R can wall him off his Q-leap, but his R (Grandmaster-at-Arms) adds armour, MR and magic damage every third hit, so a straight all-in is a coinflip unless his E is down. Get a lead here or the lane slips.

edits.before: Stack armor/MR with R Grandmaster's Might and ride the AS steroid to out-DPS your ramp in every extended fight
edits.after: Stack armour and MR with R Grandmaster-at-Arms and ride Relentless Assault's attack speed to out-DPS your ramp

edits.before: He hard-outscales you: E Counter Strike stuns your autos, W bursts your reset chain, and R resists eat your passive shred — group and don't duel him.
edits.after: He hard-outscales you: Counter Strike stuns your autos, Empower bursts your reset chain, and his R's resists blunt your on-hit — group, don't duel him.

edits.before: His R bonus resists and E Counter Strike hard-counter your auto-reliant on-hit ramp — he tanks your passive shred and stuns you out of every extended duel at 2+ items.
edits.after: His R's bonus resists and Counter Strike hard-counter your auto-reliant on-hit ramp — he tanks the ramp and stuns you out of every extended duel at 2+ items.

edits.before: Track Jax's Counter Strike: Dodges autos + stuns. Bait it. When it is down — E-stun + Q him.
edits.after: Counter Strike dodges autos then stuns — 17s at rank 1, 9s at rank 5. Bait it, then E-stun.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Empower is a 3s reset at rank 5 and his R adds resists on demand.
